4
1 # Lew 25.43; 25.53 Awuranom, momfa deɛ ɛtene, na ɛyɛ pɛ mma nkoa, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ mo nso mowɔ owura wɔ ɔsoro.
Mpaebɔ ho mmɔdemmɔ
2 # 1 Te 5.17 Monkura mpaebɔ mu ara, na momfa aseda nwɛn wɔ mu. 3#Rom 15.30; Efe 6.19; 2 Te 3.1; 1 Ko 16.9 Na mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn nso bi, na Onyankopɔn nhini asɛm no pono mma yɛn, na yɛaka Kristo ahuntasɛm a enti meda afiase yi, 4na mayi no adi, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ me sɛ mekasa. 5#Efe 5.15-16; 1 Te 4.12 Monnante nyansam wɔ ananafoɔ mu, na monnsɛe mo berɛ kwa. 6#Efe 4.29; Mar 9.50 Momma mo kasa ho mmra nyam daa a nkyene wɔ mu, na moahunu sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mobua obiara.
Tihiko ne Onesimo
7Tihiko, onua dɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔsomfoɔ nokwafoɔ ne m’awurakwaa Awurade mu no bɛba abɛka me ho nsɛm nyinaa akyerɛ mo. 8#Efe 6.22 Yei ara nti na masoma no mo nkyɛn, na moate yɛn ho asɛm, na wakyekyere mo werɛ, 9#Flm 10 na mede Onesimo, onua nokwafoɔ dɔfo a ɔfiri mo mu no, mekaa ne ho; wɔn na wɔbɛma moate ɛha nsɛm nyinaa.
Marko ne Yusto
10 # Aso 19.29; 27.2 Aristarko, me yɔnko dommum ne Barnaba wɔfase Marko a monyaa ne ho nkra no, (sɛ ɔba mo nkyɛn a, monnye no fɛ so). 11Na afei, Yesu a wɔfrɛ no Yusto, wɔn a wɔfiri twetiatwa mu no, kyea mo. Yeinom nko ne me yɔnko adwumayɛfoɔ Nyankopɔn ahennie no fam, na wɔayɛ me awerɛkyekyerɛ.
Epafra, Luka ne Dema
12 # Kol 1.7 Kristo Yesu akoa Epafra a ɔfiri mo mu no kyea mo. Daa ɔdi ma mo dendeenden wɔ mpaebɔ mu, sɛ monnyina hɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, na moayɛ ma Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ nyinaa mu. 13Na medi no ho adanseɛ sɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden pii ma mo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Hierapoli. 14#2 Ti 4.10-11; Flm 24 Luka, oduyɛfoɔ dɔfo no, ne Dema kyea mo.
Laodikea asafo
15Monkyea anuanom a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne Nimfa ne asafo a ɛwɔ ne fie no. 16Na sɛ wɔkenkan nwoma yi wɔ mo mu wie a, momma wɔnkɔkenkan no Laodikeafoɔ asafo no mu bi, na mo nso monkenkan deɛ ɛfiri Laodikea no. 17#Flm 2 Na monka nkyerɛ Arkipo sɛ: Hwɛ ɔsom a woanya no Awurade mu no so na woayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Awieeɛ
18 # 1 Ko 16.21; 2 Te 3.17 Me nkyea a me Paulo mede me nsa metwerɛ nie. Monkae me mpokyerɛ no. Adom nka mo nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Awuranom, momfa deɛ ɛtene, na ɛyɛ pɛ mma nkoa, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ mo nso mowɔ owura wɔ ɔsoro.

Monkura mpaebɔ mu ara, na momfa aseda nwɛn wɔ mu. Na mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn nso bi, na Onyankopɔn nhini asɛm no pono mma yɛn, na yɛaka Kristo ahuntasɛm a enti meda afiase yi, na mayi no adi, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ me sɛ mekasa. Monnante nyansam wɔ ananafoɔ mu, na monnsɛe mo berɛ kwa. Momma mo kasa ho mmra nyam daa a nkyene wɔ mu, na moahunu sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mobua obiara.

Tihiko, onua dɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔsomfoɔ nokwafoɔ ne m’awurakwaa Awurade mu no bɛba abɛka me ho nsɛm nyinaa akyerɛ mo. Yei ara nti na masoma no mo nkyɛn, na moate yɛn ho asɛm, na wakyekyere mo werɛ, na mede Onesimo, onua nokwafoɔ dɔfo a ɔfiri mo mu no, mekaa ne ho; wɔn na wɔbɛma moate ɛha nsɛm nyinaa.

Aristarko, me yɔnko dommum ne Barnaba wɔfase Marko a monyaa ne ho nkra no, (sɛ ɔba mo nkyɛn a, monnye no fɛ so). Na afei, Yesu a wɔfrɛ no Yusto, wɔn a wɔfiri twetiatwa mu no, kyea mo. Yeinom nko ne me yɔnko adwumayɛfoɔ Nyankopɔn ahennie no fam, na wɔayɛ me awerɛkyekyerɛ.

Kristo Yesu akoa Epafra a ɔfiri mo mu no kyea mo. Daa ɔdi ma mo dendeenden wɔ mpaebɔ mu, sɛ monnyina hɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, na moayɛ ma Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ nyinaa mu. Na medi no ho adanseɛ sɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden pii ma mo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Hierapoli. Luka, oduyɛfoɔ dɔfo no, ne Dema kyea mo.

Monkyea anuanom a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne Nimfa ne asafo a ɛwɔ ne fie no. Na sɛ wɔkenkan nwoma yi wɔ mo mu wie a, momma wɔnkɔkenkan no Laodikeafoɔ asafo no mu bi, na mo nso monkenkan deɛ ɛfiri Laodikea no. Na monka nkyerɛ Arkipo sɛ: Hwɛ ɔsom a woanya no Awurade mu no so na woayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Me nkyea a me Paulo mede me nsa metwerɛ nie. Monkae me mpokyerɛ no. Adom nka mo nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
